title: Feature Request: Android Wear Complication
symptom: The user requests an Android Wear complication that can display the most recent blood glucose reading and an arrow indicating trend, and possibly tap to see a detailed graph. They note that the existing watch face is handy but want a complication for any watch face.
fix: The complication is already available since quite a while. You just need to have a nightly build of xDrip and from an Android Wear 2.0 watch install the watch app through the app store. The complications are available then for watchfaces that support them.
